campaign_leads_recipient_ck.name: campaign_leads_recipient_ck
campaign_leads_recipient_ck.value: recipient_email IS NOT NULL OR redacted_at IS NOT NULL OR status IN ('pending', 'excluded')

campaigns_mailbox_ck.name: campaigns_mailbox_ck
campaigns_mailbox_ck.value: status IN ('draft', 'cancelled') OR mailbox_id IS NOT NULL

campaigns_start_ck.name: campaigns_start_ck
campaigns_start_ck.value: status NOT IN ('running', 'paused', 'completed', 'stopped') OR start_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL

country_policies_approval_ck.name: country_policies_approval_ck
country_policies_approval_ck.value: scope = 'demo' OR mode = 'blocked' OR (approval_ref IS NOT NULL AND approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL)

mailboxes_connected_ck.name: mailboxes_connected_ck
mailboxes_connected_ck.value: status <> 'connected' OR (address IS NOT NULL AND (provider = 'demo' OR credentials_ref IS NOT NULL))

messages_status_ck.name: messages_status_ck
messages_status_ck.value: (direction = 'out' AND status IN ('queued', 'sending', 'sent', 'failed', 'unknown')) OR (direction = 'in' AND status IN ('received', 'matched', 'unmatched', 'ignored'))

messages_delivery_ck.name: messages_delivery_ck
messages_delivery_ck.value: delivery_status IS NULL OR (direction = 'out' AND delivery_status IN ('bounced_soft', 'bounced_hard'))

messages_classification_ck.name: messages_classification_ck
messages_classification_ck.value: classification IS NULL OR classification IN ('reply', 'bounce', 'auto_reply', 'unsubscribe', 'negative', 'other')

messages_campaign_ck.name: messages_campaign_ck
messages_campaign_ck.value: direction <> 'out' OR purpose <> 'campaign' OR (campaign_id IS NOT NULL AND campaign_lead_id IS NOT NULL AND send_day IS NOT NULL AND idempotency_key IS NOT NULL)

messages_recipient_ck.name: messages_recipient_ck
messages_recipient_ck.value: direction <> 'out' OR to_address IS NOT NULL OR redacted_at IS NOT NULL

suppressions_key_ck.name: suppressions_key_ck
suppressions_key_ck.value: scope = 'domain' OR (email_hash IS NOT NULL AND hash_alg IS NOT NULL)

suppressions_lift_ck.name: suppressions_lift_ck
suppressions_lift_ck.value: lifted_at IS NULL OR lifted_reason IS NOT NULL
